typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBtoOTCTrade_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		RULE_NAME as string,
		WORKFLOW_ID as decimal(38,0),
		STATUS as string,
		POSSIBLE_ACTION as string,
		RESULTING_STATUS as string,
		CREATE_DTE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBCLYSetMarketType
OLEDBCLYSetMarketType derive(oSTATUS = STATUS,
		oRESULTING_STATUS = RESULTING_STATUS,
		oWORKFLOW_ID = toString(WORKFLOW_ID),
		oRULE_NAME = RULE_NAME,
		oCREATE_DTE = CREATE_DTE,
		oPOSSIBLE_ACTION = POSSIBLE_ACTION) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive(sImpacted_Keyword = toString('SDR_MarketType')) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Create_Dte as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Rule_Name as string,
		WORKFLOW_ID as string,
		Impacted_Keyword as string,
		Original_Status as string,
		Possible_Action as string,
		Resulting_Status as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 1000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Create_Dte = oCREATE_DTE,
		Rule_Name = oRULE_NAME,
		WORKFLOW_ID = oWORKFLOW_ID,
		Impacted_Keyword = sImpacted_Keyword,
		Original_Status = oSTATUS,
		Possible_Action = oPOSSIBLE_ACTION,
		Resulting_Status = oRESULTING_STATUS),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBtoOTCTrade_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBtoOTCTrade
